questions.explanation: Ephemeral means lasting for a very short time or temporary. "Fleeting" directly captures this meaning—describing something brief and passing quickly—making it the perfect synonym.

Benevolent means kind and generous, wishing well for others. Malevolent is its direct opposite, meaning evil or wishing harm on others. Options A and B are synonyms of benevolent, and option D is unrelated.
The word "accommodate" requires two c's and two m's. Option A is the only spelling with both double letters in the correct positions: acc-o-mm-o-date.

questions.question_text: Identify the part of speech of 'quickly' in 'She ran quickly':
questions.explanation: 'Quickly' modifies the verb 'ran' by describing how the action was performed. Words ending in '-ly' that modify verbs, adjectives, or other adverbs are adverbs, making 'quickly' an adverb.
Ubiquitous means present or found in all places at the same time. Option C directly captures this definition, while the other options describe unrelated qualities—rarity, age, or cost.
